node.title: Re^2: "Cannot find location"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Digest::MD5 ... does not include the functions I am using. ... If I remove the "::File" line I get this error...

I didn't mean that [doc://Digest::MD5] is a drop-in replacement for [mod://Digest::MD5::File], sorry for the misunderstanding. You would need to use [doc://Digest::MD5] according to its documented API. ([mod://Digest::MD5::File] appears to monkey-patch its functions into [doc://Digest::MD5], which probably just adds to the confusion.) For example, here's how you might replace the module's file_md5_hex function:

use Digest::MD5; sub file_md5_hex { my $filename = shift; open my $fh, '<:raw', $filename or die "open $filename: $!"; my $md5 = Digest::MD5->new->addfile($fh); close $fh; return $md5->hexdigest; }
